## Purpose of change
Describe the technical change and why it is necessary.

## Security and testing
- [ ] Tests added or updated; results and limitations documented
- [ ] No secrets, private data, internal infrastructure details or commercially sensitive unreleased designs included
- [ ] Changes to authorization, policy, audit, outbound access and failure recovery reviewed
- [ ] No production-readiness claim without independent evidence

## Rights and collaboration (required for external contributors)
- [ ] I have written authorization to contribute under [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md) and [LICENSE](../LICENSE)
- [ ] Background IP and any new jointly developed material are identified and appropriate written rights are in place
- [ ] No third-party license conflict, unapproved proprietary content, or unapproved redistribution

A pull request is **not** a copyright assignment, research-use license, or permission to commercialize this software. External changes are not accepted until separate written terms are established.
